Official public data, not just reviews

Which neighbourhoods are actually safe?

Wandroz shows travellers city neighbourhoods on a real interactive map, using official public data where it exists — not just online reviews. This is an early data prototype, not a finished product.

Click a pin to open that city — zoom in on any cluster to spread its cities apart.
